description: Source code implementing D-Bus authentication mechanisms, including the Auth interface, authentication process, and related helper functions.

classes.name: Auth
classes.description: Interface defining the behavior of an authentication mechanism with methods for initial data and handling data.

methods.name: Auth.FirstData
methods.description: Returns the name, response, and status for the first authentication data.

methods.name: Auth.HandleData
methods.description: Processes input data and returns response and status.

methods.name: Conn.Auth
methods.description: Performs the authentication process with a list of mechanisms.

methods.name: Conn.tryAuth
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate using a specific mechanism and state.

methods.name: authReadLine
methods.description: Reads a line from input and splits into fields.

methods.name: authWriteLine
methods.description: Writes a line in the authentication protocol format.
